730.hook: Cửa mở rồi, bạn cứ vào nhé!
730.frame: Mascot welcomes companion waiting outside open gathering doorway, ready chair visible inside.

731.hook: Tối nay ra ngoài chơi cùng mình nhé!
731.frame: Mascot sets aside indoor routine and offers companion social outing plan, cafe destination shows leisure purpose.

732.hook: Tới gần lớp mới nhớ sổ ở nhà!
732.frame: Mascot checks bag on approach to class and sees notebook missing, companion follows reconsidered home route.

734.hook: Túi còn đây, thẻ học đâu rồi?
734.frame: Mascot searches open bag and nearby book for missing class card, companion helps look without card already revealed.

737.hook: Địa chỉ vừa nghe đã quên đoạn đầu!
737.frame: Mascot's pen pauses above notebook after hearing cafe address, companion prepares to repeat while generic map stays visible.

738.hook: Mình còn chờ Lan, đừng vào lớp vội.
738.frame: Mascot waits outside class with companion, female Lan has not arrived yet; doorway and empty place remain visible.

739.hook: Muốn làm thiệp mà bàn kín hết rồi!
739.frame: Crowded craft table leaves no space for new sheet, mascot and companion prepare to organize reusable supplies.

740.hook: Cả nhóm chờ chụp, mình vẫn loay hoay!
740.frame: Mascot still handles bag beside ready photo group, photographer companion holds camera patiently.

741.hook: Bìa xanh nhé, bạn cũng chọn vậy chứ?
741.frame: Mascot proposes blue card cover, companion considers same cover rather than already agreeing.

742.hook: Lên nói mà quên mất thì sao nhỉ?
742.frame: Mascot holds prepared presentation drawings and feels nervous, companion offers cue cards; no therapeutic promise.

743.hook: Giơ thiệp thôi, mình vẫn chưa chào bạn!
743.frame: Mascot silently holds greeting card as female Lan enters, male Minh nearby; action waits for actual spoken greeting.

744.hook: Bàn trống rồi, sao mọi người vẫn cười?
744.frame: Mascot views photograph of cleared craft table and smiling group, male Minh and female Lan can tell story behind image.

745.hook: Thiệp đủ cả, sao bạn ấy chưa tới?
745.frame: Mascot and companion see prepared cards beside absent guest seat, fictional bus-delay information comes later.

746.hook: Cho mình thử, đừng chỉ để mình xem!
746.frame: Mascot reaches toward blank folding sheet while companion has finished sample, turn has not been granted yet.

747.hook: Sách bút đủ, bài tập vẫn trắng!
747.frame: Open unfinished exercise page with pen and book ready, mascot notices task remains undone beside companion.

748.hook: Giấy với bút, làm được món quà gì?
748.frame: Mascot and companion look at simple paper and pen before making card and paper flower, no finished products shown early.

749.hook: Sắp ra cửa, đừng bỏ quên ô!
749.frame: Mascot with bag turns toward umbrella still on home shelf, companion's reminder links departure and object.

750.hook: Mình tới lớp rồi, giấy vẫn chưa tới!
750.frame: Mascot at class craft table sees empty paper tray, companion arriving with bag will bring supply later.

751.hook: Viết xong mà phải dí sát mới đọc!
751.frame: Mascot brings card unusually close to see tiny writing, companion notices and prepares larger rewrite; only permitted text appears.

752.hook: Làm một thiệp, cần cả hộp bút sao?
752.frame: Mascot compares single card with full pen box, companion can provide small number of pens.

753.hook: Thêm chút nước thôi, đừng đổ cả bình!
753.frame: Mascot holds water bottle poised over thick paint tray, companion indicates small addition rather than full pouring.

754.hook: Thẻ kín bàn, mình đếm trước khi chia!
754.frame: Large card pile across table, mascot and companion prepare counting and grouping before distribution.

755.hook: Pha thêm màu, còn bao nhiêu nước nhỉ?
755.frame: Mascot and companion inspect water quantity inside bottle beside paint supplies, focus on liquid not bottle count.

756.hook: Bốn người, ba ghế: ai vẫn phải đứng?
756.frame: Four agreed adult participants at meeting table with exactly three chairs, one person standing; do not add fifth participant.

757.hook: Dán hình rồi mới biết lật nhầm mặt!
757.frame: Mascot holds card with picture placed on unintended face, companion indicates correct front/back orientation.

758.hook: Đặt túi lên bàn giúp mình với!
758.frame: Mascot reaches down toward bag under chair while companion indicates table surface as useful new position.

759.hook: Mình ở cửa, bạn tìm giữa giá sách!
759.frame: Mascot waits at library entrance, companion visible deeper among shelves, spatial mismatch is clear.

760.hook: Thiệp cho Lan, đừng trao nhầm nhé!
760.frame: Mascot separates Lan's intended card from second card, female Lan is identifiable recipient and companion helps check.

761.hook: Biết chỗ rồi, mình đi bằng gì?
761.frame: Mascot and companion compare bus and train options for fictional class route, destination remains same.

762.hook: Bàn ra sân rồi, trời sắp mưa sao?
762.frame: Outdoor craft table and approaching rain cloud, mascot and companion consider prepared indoor backup without current-weather claim.

763.hook: Nói cái hộp, bạn biết ngay hộp nào?
763.frame: Several boxes on shelf but shared selected box foreground, mascot and companion orient to previously identified object.

764.hook: Cho mình một cây bút, chiếc nào cũng được.
764.frame: Mascot requests one unspecified pen from multi-pen box to sign card, companion may choose suitable pen.

766.hook: Giấy giữa bàn, bạn kia vẫn chưa có!
766.frame: Shared paper stack lies at centre while one participant lacks sheet, mascot checks each recipient before work.

767.hook: Khoan về, còn một cửa sổ mở!
767.frame: Mascot near exit notices one open window among closed windows, companion checks whole room before leaving.

768.hook: Muốn làm thiệp, hộp này có gì nhỉ?
768.frame: Mascot and companion open craft-material box to inspect available paper and pens before knowing exact amounts.

769.hook: Mình chọn tấm nào cũng được thật chứ?
769.frame: Mascot hesitates over allowed card tray, companion grants free choice within this tray rather than all objects.

770.hook: Hai màu này chưa hợp, còn màu khác chứ?
770.frame: Mascot compares two unsuited paper colours with card illustration, companion can offer new colour options.

771.hook: Chưa rót nước, đã thấy cốc sứt!
771.frame: Mascot inspects chipped cup before pouring, companion has intact replacement nearby; water remains unpoured.
